headline: Aradel and Oando Cut Oil Production Costs by Up to 28% in Nine Months
summary: Aradel Holdings and Oando reduced their cost of producing a barrel of oil by up to 28% in the first nine months of 2026, while Seplat Energy's production cost rose.
why: Unit production costs are critical metrics for upstream oil and gas companies, directly determining cash generation and resilience to oil price volatility.

impacts.name: Oando
impacts.why: Lower production costs improve profit margins per barrel produced.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
